date: Action and date and account are always required.  Date can be YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY.  COMMENT items are ignored when importing.
For Stock Splits the ratio of old to new shares should be in the 'shares' column.
If there is no exact match to the security provided import will attempt to match to a Quicken security using the optionalSymbol (if present).
